claims.claim: A brain region previously described only for listening activates to plan each spoken word a quarter-second before vocalization.
claims.episode_span: A brain region long described only as a listening area also plans each spoken word a quarter-second ahead.
claims.source_title: A brain region known for listening helps us speak
claims.supporting_quote: Each word you say is planned by a small patch of brain above your left ear, about a quarter of a second before you say it.

claims.claim: The Milky Way’s central bar extends roughly 4.3 kiloparsecs and drives star formation along its leading edge rather than in a spiral arm.
claims.episode_span: The bar extends roughly 4.3 kiloparsecs and rotates slowly. Part of the structure previously labeled the Norma spiral arm aligns instead with this bar-driven shock front.
claims.source_title: Galactic shock: Discovery challenges our understanding of the Milky Way's structure
claims.supporting_quote: The researchers estimate the bar extends approximately 4.3 kiloparsecs—about 14,000 light-years—from the galactic center along its long axis.

claims.claim: Airborne chemicals from the barley variety SY Kestrel reduced aphid settling by more than 75 percent compared with a related line.
claims.episode_span: Airborne chemicals reduced aphid settling by more than 75 percent compared with a related line.
claims.source_title: Nature's multilayered defenses against crop pests and viruses revealed
claims.supporting_quote: In experiments, aphid settlement on SY Kestrel was reduced by more than 75% compared with a related barley variety.

claims.claim: A molecule identified at UC Berkeley increased energy expenditure by up to 18 percent in mice while preserving muscle mass.
claims.episode_span: UC Berkeley researchers identified a molecule that increased energy burn by up to 18 percent in mice. The treatment lowered liver fat, improved glucose control, and produced weight loss while preserving muscle.
claims.source_title: Experimental compound burns fat without sacrificing muscle
claims.supporting_quote: In mice, the compound boosted energy expenditure by up to 18%, improved blood sugar control, reduced liver fat, and promoted weight loss without significant muscle loss.

claims.claim: Researchers detected elevated levels of eMTBR-tau243 in blood from individuals later confirmed to have CTE at autopsy.
claims.episode_span: Researchers detected elevated levels of the protein eMTBR-tau243 in blood samples from individuals later confirmed to have chronic traumatic encephalopathy at autopsy.
claims.source_title: Blood Test May Diagnose CTE in Living People
claims.supporting_quote: We've not been able to diagnose chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) in people alive, only via post-mortem brain path findings. That may likely change with discovery of a protein (eMTBR-tau243) in the blood with independent replication
